name: Leapsome
tagline: Leapsome is a people enablement platform combining performance reviews, OKRs, employee engagement surveys, learning, and compensation management. Its AI features include AI-generated review summaries, sentiment analysis of open-text feedback, and skills gap analysis that recommends learning content to employees.
